facts_raw.Program: Founders Factory Northwestern Medicine Healthcare Accelerator
facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: US$150K cash investment + 16 weeks support + ~$300K deals/perks + Northwestern Medicine pilot access
facts_raw.Capital Disclosure Status: Verified — Cash Public / Exact Equity Terms Not Published on Current Page
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: European/UK AI-enabled health technologies with US healthcare commercialization potential.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site Required: Hybrid with mandatory/high-value Chicago Residency Week
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 16 weeks; Chicago Residency Week in Aug 2026 + London investor showcase.
facts_raw.International Founder: 可能接受国际 founder；需确认签证/现场要求
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Name: Olivia Brooks / Hannah Koczka / Salvatore LoGrasso
facts_raw.Public Contact Role: Head of Investments / VP Ventures & Innovation / Program Director
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: MedTech / Health / Bio；阶段以 Pre-seed–seed 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；缺少核心技术/IP、仅做轻量同质化应用或贸易型项目
facts_raw.Notes: Listed closed in current Founders Factory directory.
